subject: POC timeline & success criteria — Acme Industries
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Brooks <daniel.brooks@acme.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed POC plan (success criteria & timeline)

Thanks again for a great discovery call today — appreciate the context on Acme's search and knowledge base use cases. Per our convo, I pulled together a concise plan to get a 2-week POC running that validates latency, relevancy, and integration effort. High-level summary:

Goal: Prove Redwood can serve product-search re-rank and static knowledge responses within SLA and cost targets.

Proposed success criteria (pass/fail checkpoints):
- Relevancy: RMS@5 >= 0.72 on your eval set OR clear improvement over current baseline by >8%
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 450ms for common queries
- Cost: Estimated per-1k-query token cost within your budget target (we'll provide an optimized config)
- Integration effort: embedding + rerank endpoint integration completed within 2 sprint cycles, with docs and sample code

Timeline (suggested):
- Week 0 (next week): Kickoff + environment access (API keys, sample dataset, SSO if needed)
- Week 1: Model tuning, batching/caching config, initial relevance tests
- Week 2: Final readout, handoff materials, decision on next steps (pilot/contract)

Ownership / next steps:
- Marissa (me): Overall POC owner, rollout coordination, weekly check-ins
- Neha (CS): Technical onboarding, runbook, and support for integration questions
- Daniel / Priya (Acme): Provide eval set, sample traffic patterns, and a primary internal reviewer for results

Action items for this week:
1) Can you share the 1000-query eval sample + any SSO/network constraints by EOD Monday?
2) Pick a kickoff slot (I proposed 10am or 2pm PT on Thu/Mar 3 below)

I've attached a mutual action plan (MAP) and a draft SLA we can use for the POC. If this looks good, I'll lock the kickoff and schedule weekly 30-min check-ins.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RDW_Acme_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx, Redwood_SLA_Draft.pdf

From: Daniel Brooks <daniel.brooks@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, Oliver Price <oliver.price@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed POC plan (success criteria & timeline)

Thanks Marissa — this is super helpful and aligns with what we discussed. A few quick clarifications/questions:

- Eval set: We'll send a 1k sample by Monday morning. We'll also include a small set of edge-case queries for latency-sensitive flows.
- Success criteria: RMS@5 target looks reasonable; can we add a qualitative sign-off from our search PM (Priya) as part of the acceptance criteria?
- Kickoff timing: Thu, Mar 3 at 10am PT works for our engineers.

One ask from procurement (Oliver is cc'd): any POC-related contracting we should expect? For a time-boxed POC we usually do an MSA + short SOW or a POC addendum. Oliver — can you share Acme's POC review timeline?

Thanks — will wait for the MAP and draft SLA.

Cheers,
Daniel
Director, Search Engineering
Acme Industries

From: Oliver Price <oliver.price@acme.com>
To: Daniel Brooks <daniel.brooks@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed POC plan (success criteria & timeline)

Marissa — procurement here. For a two-week POC we typically need:
- A simple POC addendum (terms: limited liability, data handling, termination)
- Expected delivery/acceptance criteria documented
- Invoice upon kickoff or after delivery depending on scope

If Redwood can provide the MAP and a short SOW, our legal team can turn the addendum around in ~5 business days. If there are any standard Redwood compliance artifacts (SOC 2 report, DPA), please include those.

Oliver Price
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Industries

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Brooks <daniel.brooks@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, Oliver Price <oliver.price@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed POC plan (success criteria & timeline)

Appreciate the quick replies — next steps and updates below.

1) MAP & SLA: Attached v1 of the Mutual Action Plan (RDW_Acme_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx) and Redwood_SLA_Draft.pdf. The MAP includes milestone owners and dates.

2) Kickoff: Confirmed Thu, Mar 3 at 10:00am PT. I'll send the calendar invite once I get a final attendee list.

3) Data & compliance: Per Oliver's note, attaching our SOC 2 summary and a short DPA excerpt in the next email. We'll also include the expected POC addendum template for your legal review.

4) Weekly cadence: Propose 30-min check-ins on Wednesdays at 9am PT during the POC (first one Wed, Mar 9). These will be focused on progress against the MAP and any blocker tracking. Neha will run technical onboarding.

Outstanding asks for Acme:
- Daniel / Priya: 1k eval sample + edge-case queries (by Mon 3/1)
- Procurement: any preferred PO or SOW language we should be aware of

If everyone is aligned I'll send the invite and MAP as a shared Drive link later today.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>

- Eval set: sent via S3 link this morning (shared with marissa.neha@redwood.ai) — includes metadata and labels
- Kickoff invite: Accepted for Thu 3/3 10am PT.

Looking forward to the kickoff and the weekly syncs. Neha — happy to get on an intake call before kickoff if useful.

Best,
Priya

Acme Industries
